I can't answer that from this evidence. The tool checked 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the month after your date, not the two weeks before it. Nothing in the output covers 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.

For the period it did check, NASA FIRMS found no thermal detections intersecting the property (0 detections). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period.

Even for that period, this wouldn't prove no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area or cause.

To answer your question, the check needs to be re-run for the interval 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.
